description: Removal of Condition 6 (Resident Parking Permits) to allow residents of the three previously approved flats to obtain and retain Resident Parking Permits from the Local Authority of Planning Permission P/2023/1203 approved 20/06/2023 for the 'Erection of a rear roof extension with one front roof window and a single storey rear extension following the demolition of the existing conservatory to create three self contained residential units'.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed removal of Condition 6 (Resident Parking Permits) of Planning Permission P/2023/1203 to allow residents of the development's three flats unrestricted access to obtain and retain resident parking permits for use in Chiswick West Controlled Parking Zone (within which the site is located) would not be justified by reason of an incorrect methodology being used to undertake the completed parking stress surveys summarised in the submitted Parking Stress Survey Report, which does not comply with the Council's preferred London Borough of Lambeth parking stress survey methodology, and therefore would not accurately demonstrate that the application's modelled car parking occupancy level within Chiswick West Controlled Parking Zone would not exceed the borough's maximum 90% threshold, contrary to London Plan Policy T6 and Local Plan Policy EC2.
